name: Triple modular redundancy
idea: Run three copies of the same unit and let a majority voter mask any single faulty one.

name: Quorum consensus
idea: Only commit a value once enough replicas vote for it, so one unstable replica cannot decide the outcome.

name: Damping
idea: Shed the energy of an oscillating system so its swings die out; here, average many samples so answer-to-answer swings cancel.

name: Independent verification and validation
idea: A separate review pass checks the work against the requirements before it ships. Here the checker is the same model, so it is only partly independent.

name: Double-entry bookkeeping
idea: Record every transaction twice and investigate whenever the two sides do not balance; here, answer twice cheaply and escalate to a stronger model when they disagree.

name: Surgical safety checklist
idea: Pause at fixed points and confirm a short list of items out loud, so routine slips are caught before they matter.

mutation.text: Before the ANSWER line, run this checklist: (1) re-read the input and name the decisive detail; (2) confirm the answer follows from that detail; (3) confirm the answer uses the required format: {labels}.

name: Poka-yoke (mistake-proofing)
idea: Shape the process so the wrong part physically cannot fit; here, constrain the answer to the exact allowed strings.

mutation.text: The ANSWER line must contain exactly one of these, copied character for character and nothing else: {labels}.

name: Differential diagnosis
idea: List the conditions that look alike and name the finding that tells them apart before committing to one.

mutation.text: These answers are often confused: {confusions}. When the input could fit more than one of them, name the detail that separates them before answering.

name: Emergency triage
idea: Sort cases by urgency so scarce expert attention goes only where it changes the outcome; here, a cheap model handles cases it is sure about and escalates the rest.

name: Flight planning
idea: Work out the route, fuel and weather before take-off instead of improvising in the air; here, write a plan before answering.

name: Specialist referral
idea: Hand cases the generalist keeps getting wrong to a more capable specialist; here, move the design up one model tier.

name: Load shedding
idea: Deliberately drop demand during a shortfall so the grid stays up; here, move the design down one model tier so it fits the cost, latency or timeout limits.
